caption: The drawing depicts a young child, presumably a boy, standing and facing forward, dressed in a mid-length, pale blue-green coat that is belted at the waist with a dark sash. The coat has long sleeves with large, decorative cuffs and white undersleeves visible at the wrists; the cuffs are edged with white ruffles. The coat opens at the front, displaying an inner section with brownish vertical stripes that have intricate yellow and orange patterns near the bottom hem. The child is wearing a white garment underneath, including visible stockings, and black shoes with a strap across the top. The figure’s left arm is lowered and holding a flower, while the right arm is bent with the hand touching the chest. Around the neck is a small black bow or ribbon. The child’s hair is brown, parted at the center, smoothed back, and tied at the nape with curls at the sides. The face is left blank and without features. The background is an unadorned, lightly yellowed paper, and there is printed text in the bottom right corner identifying the drawing as "Boy Child's Dress" and attributing it to a portrait by James Badger, painted by Joseph Badger, and noting that the shoes and hairstyle are of the same period. The drawing is executed in colored pencils or similar media.
title: Boy's Dress
